## Need or opportunity

Who is affected, and what would improve for them?

## Proposal

Describe the idea, its scope, and any alternatives considered.

## People, resources, and dependencies

Who needs to be involved? What time, funding, permissions, or other work does this depend on?

## Decision and next step

What feedback or decision are you seeking, and from whom? State whether this is exploratory or already agreed, and link any public decision record. Community commitments need the relevant stewardship process; opening or closing this issue is not approval.
